title: introduce-session-affinity-and-token-pinning-unify-retry-presets-across-py-ts-go
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: Multiple SDK users reported edge cases when long-lived streaming sessions cross network boundaries or when token refreshes race with active frames. This PR introduces a lightweight session-affinity layer (token pinning) and harmonizes default retry/backoff presets across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs. The goal is to reduce transient 401s during streaming, provide a clear ergonomic surface for session lifecycle hooks, and ship consistent defaults so teams don't have to hand-roll per-language backoff policies.

Summary of changes: 1) SDK surface: add SessionAffinity config and SessionInspector hook to Python/TS/Go SDKs; these are opt-in by default but enabled on the Redwood hosted SDK bundles. 2) Auth: introduce token-pinning semantics during active stream windows to avoid mid-stream credential swaps unless explicitly forced. 3) Retries: unify the retry preset names (fast, balanced, conservative) and normalize backoff coefficients and max attempts. 4) Streaming ergonomics: add a small event emitter (on_resume, on_prefetch, on_pin_loss) and a convenience context-manager / finally-style guard for Python; a similarly ergonomic async iterator helper for TS; and a deferable session-heartbeat helper for Go. 5) CI / release: bump SDK versions (py 2.5.0, ts 1.9.0, go 1.7.1) and add a short compatibility test matrix to catch token-swap races.

Backward compatibility and migration: defaults remain backward compatible: session-affinity is opt-in except for hosted SDK bundles where we enable it behind a feature flag. Existing code will continue to work. If teams rely on immediate credential swapping semantics, they should explicitly set session_affinity: false. The PR includes a docs page describing semantics and a migration checklist.

Testing and validation: unit tests added across all SDKs covering: pinned-token refresh path, stream resumption when pin lost, retry preset behavior under transient 5xx and 401s, and cross-language smoke tests using the local canary harness. One flaky integ test was retried in CI; it was caused by timing in the canary harness and has been stabilized.

Rollout plan: merge -> feature flag on for internal canary -> opt-in in public SDK bundles for one week -> enable in hosted bundle behind telemetry gating (observe 401->200 bounce reduction). If regressions observed, revert via feature flag.

Notes: this PR intentionally keeps the pin window conservative (default 30s of active stream without new handshake) to avoid long-lived pins for heavy multi-tenant flows. Admins can override via session_affinity.window_seconds.

Files changed (high level): see changed_files.

release_notes:
- Add SessionAffinity (token pinning) to Python / TypeScript / Go SDKs to reduce mid-stream credential race conditions.
- Introduce SessionInspector hooks and lightweight stream event emitters (on_resume, on_prefetch, on_pin_loss).
- Unify retry preset names and defaults (fast, balanced, conservative) across SDKs.
- Bump versions: py 2.5.0, ts 1.9.0, go 1.7.1.
